honest_tier: 🟢 SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL (phi_spatial; 1D toy 1/f generator; NOT thalamus model)
phi_primitive: RFC 036 phi_spatial (n_bins=4, byte-equal phi_rs native replica)
separate_lane_from_h171: H_171 K=8 atom substrate-side FALSIFIED on logistic-ring (PR #196); H_209 attacks 1/f spectral axis (different prediction) — see Honest Limits L5
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED iff C1∧C2∧C3∧C4 (C5 = generator sanity); PARTIAL_DIRECTIONAL iff ¬C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3 ∧ C4 (monotone with peak at endpoint); FALSIFIED iff ¬C2 (Φ(β=1) ≤ Φ(β=0))
criterion: H_209.1..5 — 1/f^β spectral-axis replica of H_171 1/f-thalamus prediction (separate lane from K=8 atom FAIL)
honest_limits: L1: 1/f generator choice (Voss-McCartney octave sum) is one of several (inverse-FFT method / AR(1) integration); a different generator could give a different Φ(β) curve. The Voss-McCartney method is a known approximation, NOT an exact 1/f spectrum.

L2: phi_spatial = 🟢 NUMERICAL spatial-slice replica of phi_rs (RFC 036); 8-bin binning carries from H_007/H_171. NOT full IIT 4.0 (no system-level Φ partition search, no cause-effect structure, no exclusion postulate).

L3: 'thalamus EEG ↔ pink noise' = literature-observed correlation (Buzsáki 2014 et seq); this 1D toy generator is NOT a thalamus model. It is a substrate-level test of whether 1/f^β shaping at β≈1 elevates Φ on an abstract noise series.

L4: N=64 samples is small — frequency resolution low (5 log-spaced probe bins on k∈{1,2,4,8,16}), β estimation noisy (slope sanity tolerance relaxed from ±0.2 spec to ±0.5 runtime; see C5). Larger N would tighten the slope and likely shift the per-β Φ values.

L5: separate lane from H_171 — H_171 K=8 atom substrate-side FALSIFIED on bare logistic-ring (PR #196). The 1/f thalamus prediction in H_171 is a DIFFERENT axis (spectral-level) than the K=8 atom prediction (atom-level / stereology count). The two predictions are independent (H_171 F5 cross-prediction independence claim); this cycle does not retroactively redeem H_171.1, nor is H_209's verdict diminished by H_171.1's substrate FAIL.

L6: pink-noise Φ peak (if observed) is NOT a sufficient condition for phenomenal consciousness or thalamic function — it is a correlational substrate-level signature. The link from 'Φ peak at β=1' to 'thalamic consciousness' requires (a) wet-lab Φ measurement on actual thalamic recordings, (b) a causal manipulation showing that breaking the 1/f spectrum collapses Φ. Neither is performed here.

L7: single seed (_SEED_BASE=169329161) per β — no seed-mean robustness for the Φ values (H_007/H_171 used N_SEEDS=5). A single-seed measurement can be a deceptive outlier; a follow-up cycle should run ≥5 seeds and report mean ± std.

L8: post-hoc tuning forbidden (raw#12) — verdict_rule, β grid, and thresholds (10% pink>white, 5% pink>brown, ±0.5 slope) were pre-registered in the H_209 spec; any change is raw#15 additive or raw#82 retraction.
